A '''missile boat''' was a type of combat [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] converted a number of civilian vessels into missile boats to serve in their [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|armada]].<ref name="ATPA">{{WEGCite|story=Against the Pirate Armada|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
